artworks.title: Giuseppina Massimi, Principessa Lancellotti di Lauro
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image is a detailed pencil sketch showing the head and shoulders of a person. The person is positioned facing forward, slightly tilted to the left. They have distinct facial features: a straight nose, full lips, and large, expressive eyes. Their hair is styled in tight curls that frame the face, with some sections likely pinned up. The sketch captures no evident clothing details below the shoulders, and there are no visible accessories or objects being held. The background of the image is blank.

artworks.title: Dante and Virgil Riding on the Back of Geryon
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on laid paper, fragments of graphite borderlines at top, left, and bottom
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is an illustration showing figures riding a creature and a group of people engaged in a scene. Two figures are atop a mythical creature resembling a dragon with spiral details. The figures are dressed in flowing garments and appear to be in motion as they ride through clouds. Below them, a group of nude figures are shown in various poses, expressing movement and intensity. The drawing is filled with swirling lines that convey drama and tension.

artworks.title: A View across the Inn Valley to the Alps and Neubeuern
artworks.medium: pen and gray and brown ink with watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a large tree in the foreground on the right. The terrain includes earthy browns and greens, leading to rolling hills with various trees in the background. The horizon is high in the image, showing distant mountains and a faint outline of a structure or settlement under a serene sky. The color palette is soft with earth tones, yellow, green, and blue, creating a tranquil atmosphere. The brushstrokes in the watercolor painting are delicate, capturing details of foliage, light, and shadow across the landscape.

artworks.title: Malresl Working in the Kitchen
artworks.medium: graphite with stumping and erasures on polished wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image is a charcoal sketch of a person seated with a three-quarter body view. The individual is facing slightly to the left. They have defined cheekbones, a slight pursed expression, and short combed hair. The person is dressed in attire with a visible collar and a bow tie. The background shows a window with crossed panes near their head, casting shadows. There is a dark shaded area representing the wall behind the person. The sketch is signed by the artist in the lower-left corner.

artworks.title: Hilly Landscape with a Stream
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper, with framing line in graphite (partially cropped)
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated point of view, featuring a natural scene. The horizon is suggested by the meeting of the sky and distant hills. The brushstrokes are distinct and lively, utilizing short, repetitive strokes to provide texture to the trees and grassy areas. The color palette consists of earthy tones with greens and browns for the foliage and land, contrasted by the soft blue of the sky and the water. The scene conveys a rustic and vibrant essence of nature.

artworks.title: The Waterfalls at Tivoli (recto)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash and watercolor, heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays cascading waterfalls flowing down rocky terrain. The perspective is slightly elevated, offering a view of the waterfalls and the hill they descend from. Towards the top of the image, a hill with structures, including a building or tower, can be seen. The brushstrokes are loose and impressionistic, conveying the water's motion and the landscape's texture. The color scheme is earthy, with greens, browns, whites, and grays. The sky appears overcast, hinted at by soft brushstrokes indicating clouds. The artwork depicts a serene natural scene, created with a watercolor and pen technique highlighting texture and light.

artworks.title: Atlases on the Wallpavillon of the Dresden Zwinger
artworks.medium: graphite with stumping, on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two sculpted figures on the facade of a building. The figures are likely atlantes, which are male figures used as architectural supports. Both figures are depicted in a classical style with muscular builds. The figure on the left has its hands placed behind its head, while the figure on the right also has its arms bent and hands raised above its head. The figures are draped with cloth around their lower bodies, and there are intricate carved details such as floral garlands and swirling decorative elements. The sculpture is monochromatic, suggesting it is made of stone or plaster. Each figure is intricately carved with attention to anatomical detail. The setting suggests a baroque or classical architectural style with ornate embellishments framing the figures.

artworks.title: An Elegant Company Playing Board Games
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash, corrected with white gouache, over traces of graphite, on laid paper, incised throughout, the verso reddened for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Rococo-style interior or garden terrace featuring a group of well-dressed figures engaged in leisurely activities. The setting includes elaborate architectural and decorative elements, vases with floral arrangements, and intricately carved details. The characters are depicted in conversation and playing a board game, embodying the elegance and refinement of the Rococo period.

artworks.title: The Immaculate Conception
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash, heightened and corrected with white and blue gouache over graphite on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures among clouds. The central figure is a robed figure seated on clouds, surrounded by smaller winged figures. The composition features flowing drapery and various posed figures. The background is filled with additional figures emerging or dissolving into the clouds. The blue-gray palette gives a serene quality to the image. The figures are detailed with attention to expressions and posture. The lower section of the drawing is inscribed.

artworks.title: A Thesis Design with Doctors of the Church
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash and traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in an ornate setting. The drawing is made with intricate line work and shading in sepia tones. The figures are surrounded by clouds. In the upper section, two central figures are elevated among the clouds. One figure holds a large cross towards a light source from above. Below, a group of three individuals appear to be in discussion, wearing robes and tall hats. The borders of the drawing contain cherubic figures and baroque embellishments. Blank spaces within the borders suggest areas for inscriptions or additional details. The composition blends allegorical and architectural elements, embodying artistry and symbolism.

artworks.title: Antiquities by a Balcony Overlooking the Gulf of Naples
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite, with borderlines in brush and black ink, on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund

artworks.title: Figure Studies
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Ladislaus and Beatrix von Hoffmann
artworks.description: The image displays sketches of four male figures in various poses and angles on a plain background. The figures include a man pointing, a man sitting on a rock, another seated man handling a rope or strap, and a standing man with a hand on his cheek.

artworks.title: The Stoning of Saint Stephen
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring heavenly and earthly realms. The image depicts a scene with celestial figures in the clouds at the top of the painting. These figures include angels and a dove. Below, a group of people is gathered in a scene of intensity. The scene is set against a backdrop of architectural elements like towers and buildings to the side. The composition balances spectral and earthly elements with figures dynamically posed, their gestures and expressions strongly conveyed.

artworks.title: Saint Ignatius Leaving Antioch
artworks.medium: watercolor, white gouache, black wash, and pen and black ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Diane A. Nixon
artworks.description: This is a painting of a gathering of figures at an architectural backdrop. The figures are dressed in ornate robes, standing around a central figure in front of elegant buildings with archways and columns. The scene shows dynamic movements and grand gestures, creating a sense of significance. The color palette is soft and vibrant, with pastel hues and metallic details. Architectural elements blend into a painted sky with swirling clouds. Decorative borders frame the scene, focusing on the central action. The style is reminiscent of Francesco Guardi.

artworks.title: Ladies and Gentlemen Playing Billiards
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and black wash over traces of graphite, heightened with white gouache on laid paper, incised throughout and laid down
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows several individuals playing billiards in an ornate parlor. The composition includes full-body views of people around a large billiards table. One person stands in the center, holding a pool cue. Another figure lies across the table, interacting with someone leaning over with a cue. The people are dressed in 18th-century clothing, with ruffled shirts, waistcoats, long coats, and women in full-length dresses with detailed sleeves. The individuals' hair is styled according to the period, including wigs and neatly coiffed hair. The background features windows, wall panels, and decorative moldings, with an overhead light fixture above the table and a baroque-style scrollwork frame surrounding the scene.

artworks.title: The Horrors of War: A Sea Battle
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over graphite, incised throughout and verso reddened for transfer, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological sea creatures and ships in a dramatic scene set in a tumultuous sea. The drawing depicts mythological figures and creatures intertwined with waves and clouds, with sailing ships navigating the stormy waters in the background. Elaborate ornamental designs frame the scene, adding grandeur and baroque flair to the composition. The composition is executed with a fluid and expressive use of line, creating a dynamic and lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: "The Blue Pool" in the Rein Valley near Garmisch
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a lake surrounded by mountains. Rocky terrain with a figure and a dog is in the foreground, leading to the blue lake reflecting the sky. Trees line the slopes down to the lake. The painting features precise brushstrokes, delicate textures, and a color palette of earth tones and soft blues.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait Sketching
artworks.medium: black, red, blue, yellow, and white chalks, with stumping on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person depicted from the waist up. The person is sitting with their left arm resting on a surface, holding a fountain pen in their right hand, poised above a piece of paper. They have a youthful face with a subtle, neutral expression, and their hair is mostly covered by a large, voluminous beret. The individual's attire consists of a rustic, long-sleeved jacket over a high-collared shirt. The jacket is slightly open, revealing a dark garment underneath. They are wearing light-colored gloves, and the room is simply furnished with what appears to be a plain backdrop. The upper left shows the signature "G. F. Schmidt" and a date from 1752.

artworks.title: The Artist's Wife with a Book
artworks.medium: black, red, yellow, and blue chalks, with stumping, on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman's body seated in a chair. She is facing slightly toward her left, with her right hand raised, index finger pointing upward, and her left hand resting on the pages of an open book in front of her. Her facial features include a round face, gentle eyes, and a subtle smile. She has light hair neatly pulled back under a lace cap adorned with small flowers. She is dressed in a light-colored blouse with voluminous sleeves and a black lace scarf tied with a yellow bow around her neck. The woman wears drop earrings, but no other jewelry is visible. The background is a simple, neutral color that puts focus on her and the book.

artworks.title: Gustav Heinrich Naeke
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The sketch depicts the upper half of a person's body, focusing on their head and upper torso in a side profile position facing right. The person has distinct facial features with a straight nose, defined cheekbones, and an attentive gaze. Their hair is medium in length, reaching just past the ears and is smooth and parted slightly to the side. They are wearing a garment with a high collar and buttons running down the front. The background is a plain, neutral surface.

artworks.title: A Woodland Path in Rosenthal in Winter
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and brown wash over graphite on light blue-green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Joan and David Maxwell

artworks.title: Saint Augustine Subdues Heresy with Lightning Bolts from His Pen
artworks.medium: watercolor with pen and brown and gray ink over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring a complex scene with architectural, human, and possibly mythical elements. In the center, there are figures engaged in various activities within a grand architectural setting with a domed ceiling and columns. A seated figure on a pedestal appears to be writing or marking documents, surrounded by others performing related tasks. On the left, there is a tall architectural feature resembling a spire wrapped with vegetation. The lower portion of the scene includes figures in reclining or active postures, some with exaggerated physical features that could suggest mythical or symbolic themes. The style is reminiscent of a Baroque-inspired artist, characterized by a dramatic composition and detailed ornamentation.

artworks.title: The Stigmatization of Saint Francis
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This image depicts a religious scene with a celestial interaction. It features a figure in a robe reaching upwards towards an angelic figure descending from above, surrounded by cherubs and light. The angelic figure is winged and holds a palm frond. The background shows clouds and faint architecture in the distance, with additional elements like draped robes, foliage, sandals, and a skull at the base. The composition is intricate with detailed expressions and movement, set within an arch-shaped frame.

artworks.title: Rocks and Oaks in the Serpentara
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated viewpoint with trees, rocks, and grass in the foreground. The brushstrokes are detailed, with warm and naturalistic colors of brown, gray, green, and blue. In the distance, there are two figures near a group of sheep.
